agent.reasons: The entity is not excluded, and no control person has been identified (control_person is null). Under 3.2 that means requesting documents. Everything else checks out: ownership adds up to 100% across two verified individuals, the registry filing (2025-11-17) is under 12 months old, all sanctions, PEP and adverse media checks are clear, the industry is normal and all parties are in the US. So nothing more severe than request documents applies.
still_needed: Name and identity verification of a control person (an individual with significant responsibility to control, manage or direct the entity), plus sanctions, PEP and adverse media screening on that person
Records of the adverse media searches (terms, date, sources reviewed) required by 4.4
